name: Explore a piece of furniture
description: See every support layer of one piece of furniture (each shelf, the top, a cabinet's inside shelves): sweep from where the robot stands when it is already near, else from up to three stand-off poses in front of it, aiming the head at each layer not seen yet, then again with the torso lowered for the layers still hidden (a bottom shelf behind the front edge of the shelf above). A layer is seen when the space just above its board is in the head camera and no board of the piece is in the way. Succeeds only when every layer was seen; a closed cabinet door hides its inside layers.

furniture.description: The bookcase, shelf unit, table, desk or cabinet to cover.

verifier.name: furniture_explored
verifier.meaning: Every support layer of the furniture (each shelf, the top) was seen in the head camera.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: an object seen on a layer must be fetched
relations.reason: the seen output names the objects on the layers

relations.when: a closed cabinet door hides the inside layers
relations.reason: an open door uncovers the inside shelves; explore again

relations.when: only one layer must be seen

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
